messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: p99 request latency > 3s for /v1/streaming/generate (service: runtime) — paging oncall (sev: p1) :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Metrics snapshot: p95=420ms, p99=3.4s, streaming stalls ↑ (sessions with chunked frames stalled). Affected cluster: gpu-pool-prod-7.

sara_oncall: on it. grabbing logs and checking node list. anyone on infra? @maya_infra?

maya_infra: I see elevated ECC correctable errors on gpu-12 and gpu-14 in node-az3-rack4. Thermal sensors for gpu-12 reporting 87C spikes with fan RPM oscillation. Kernel logs show repeated `gpu_ecc_correctable` messages and a few `gpu_throttle` events.

ben_sre: confirmed correlation with high KV-cache miss rates for streaming contexts pinned to those nodes — when a GPU misbehaves KV cache hits drop and we see tail amplification. Recommend immediate isolate/evacuate of node-az3-rack4-12.

alex_runtime: rolling fallback policy should route new sessions to warm standby replicas, but existing streaming sessions are sticky. We can trigger graceful handoff with `runtimectl migrate-session --node node-az3-rack4-12 --mode drain` to force reconnects (will cause short reconnects for active streams).

zane_support: Customer impact: monitoring shows ~320 active streaming sessions impacted, ~6 customers with degraded experience (chat UIs show pauses ~2–7s). CS alerted key accounts.

sara_oncall: ok plan: 1) reduce new traffic to pool (rate-limit/burst cap) 2) drain problematic node 3) hot-swap with spare GPU node 4) escalate hardware if ECC keeps happening. Any objections?

ben_sre: +1. Also enable conservative batching on remaining nodes to reduce tail risk: set `max_batch_size=16` and `batch_timeout_ms=12` for the next 10m. That buys headroom.

maya_infra: Starting drain: `kubectl cordon node/node-az3-rack4-12` then `kubectl drain node/node-az3-rack4-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30`. Kube-level eviction in progress.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: route override applied to shift 40% of new streaming traffic from gpu-pool-prod-7 to gpu-pool-prod-3 for 15m (policy: live-mitigation-1768887777).

sara_oncall: running `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,THERMAL` output (excerpt):
```
GPU 12
    ECC Errors (Corrected): 432
    ECC Errors (Uncorrected): 0
    Temperature
        GPU Current Temp : 87 C
        GPU Slowdown Temp : 95 C
    Retired Pages: 2
GPU 14
    ECC Errors (Corrected): 98
```

ben_sre: that's... a lot of correctable ECCs. Could indicate early hardware degradation. Also seeing `nv_peer_mem` farm retries in dmesg for that node.

alex_runtime: Observability note: streaming p99 is dominated by sessions with >8k tokens that hit KV-cache misses. We'll push a temporary policy to prefer cached model variants for those sessions. Patching now.

maya_infra: Node drained. Evictions completed, pod migrate success count: 42. Marking node as unschedulable.

sara_oncall: after drain p99 dropped to 980ms (from 3.4s) within 2 mins, p95 steady ~410ms. Streaming stall alerts faded.

zane_support: Customer-facing update drafted and sent to affected accounts: short outage + reconnects, we offered 2 days of credit. CS will follow up.

ben_sre: next actions: open HW ticket for GPU vendor RMA on node-az3-rack4-12, schedule deep burn test on node-az3-rack4-14. Also add alert rule: if ECC corrected > 100 in 1h -> auto-quarantine.

maya_infra: Filed ticket REF#HW-38102, attached `nvidia-smi` dump and dmesg. Will attempt to repro in isolated bench.

alex_runtime: Follow-up: we'll run an eval against our canary prompt set for streaming tailcases to ensure generation quality unchanged after route override. Also will instrument session reconnect success metric.

sara_oncall: Good. TL;DR: root cause likely flaky GPU (correctable ECC + thermal spikes) -> caused KV-cache disruptions and streaming tail amplification -> p99 breach. Mitigations: drained node, shifted traffic, reduced batching, fallback variant, HW RMA.

ben_sre: Postmortem owners? assigning to maya_infra (investigation + hardware), alex_runtime (runtime sticky session behavior + mitigation automation), zane_support (customer comms). I'll draft initial incident timeline.

sara_oncall: I'll run the retro tomorrow 10:30am PT. Adding action items to incident board: quarantine rule, automated drain on ECC threshold, improve session handoff grace.

zane_support: Noted. I'll consolidate impacted customers list and escalate to account owners.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Impact mitigated, p99 below SLO threshold. Please update the incident ticket and complete postmortem within 72h. :white_check_mark:

sara_oncall: thanks everyone. leaving detailed logs and commands in incident ticket. cc: @oncall-all for visibility.

ben_sre: Reaction :thumbsup:

maya_infra: Reaction :wrench:

alex_runtime: Reaction :rocket:

zane_support: Reaction :heart:
